# bain.com

> Bain & Company is a global management consulting firm that helps the world’s leading businesses and organizations solve their most critical challenges and achieve sustainable, industry-defining results.

## Consulting Services

- [Consulting Services](https://www.bain.com/consulting-services/): Our management consulting services focus on our clients' most critical issues and opportunities: strategy, marketing, organization, operations, technology, transformation, digital, advanced analytics, corporate finance, mergers & acquisitions and sustainability across all industries and geographies. We bring deep, functional expertise, but are known for our holistic perspective: we capture value across boundaries and between the silos of any organization. We have proven a multiplier effect from optimizing the sum of the parts, not just the individual pieces.
- [AI Consulting Services](https://www.bain.com/vector-digital/advanced-analytics/artificial-intelligence/): Our AI consultants are helping clients strategically consider, build, and implement AI to improve efficiency, retention, and time-to-market.
- [Change Management & Implementation Consulting Services](https://www.bain.com/consulting-services/change-management-results-delivery/): Mastering change at speed & scale is vital for performance. Our change management & implementation consultants offers the tools & training you need to succeed.
- [Marketing & Sales Consulting Services](https://www.bain.com/consulting-services/customer-strategy-and-marketing/): Our marketing & sales consultants provide the expert-level insights, tools & benchmarks you need to transform how you meet customer needs.
- [Customer Experience Consulting | Bain](https://www.bain.com/consulting-services/customer-strategy-and-marketing/customer-experience-transformation/): With breakthrough insights & benchmarking tools, our CX experts help businesses deliver real results: happier customers, employees & shareholders.
- [Digital Transformation Consulting Services](https://www.bain.com/consulting-services/digital-transformation/): Our digital transformation consultants work side-by-side with you to design, build and scale truly transformative digital businesses.
- [Business Building - Next℠](https://www.bain.com/consulting-services/innovation/): Next is our solution for new business building. We partner with founders as they envision, create, and accelerate ventures from seed to scale.
- [M&A Consulting Services](https://www.bain.com/consulting-services/mergers-acquisitions/): Our M&A consulting experts can help you achieve consistently higher returns with a systematic and repeatable approach to mergers and acquisitions.
- [Operations Consulting](https://www.bain.com/consulting-services/operations/): Our operations consulting experts can help you transform your operations from end-to-end. From the office & lab, to the factory & across your supply chain.
- [People & Organizational Consulting Organizational Strategy](https://www.bain.com/consulting-services/organization/): Our organizational consultants help clients improve financial performance and create better workplaces by aligning the organization to achieve its objectives.
- [Strategy Consulting](https://www.bain.com/consulting-services/strategy/): Since Bain's founding in 1973, strategy has been our core business. We work with companies in every industry to develop strategies that deliver results.
- [Sustainability Consulting](https://www.bain.com/consulting-services/sustainability-corporate-responsibility/): Our sustainability consultants will help integrate sustainability into your operations to enhance efficiency, encourage innovation, and strengthen your brand.
- [Business Transformation Consulting Services](https://www.bain.com/consulting-services/transformation/): Business transformations are at the core of what we've done at Bain for over 50 years. Ready for a change? Our consultants can help.
- [Digital Consulting Services](https://www.bain.com/vector-digital/): Our team of digital consultants and technical experts, leverage engineering, AI, and data science to build and scale tech solutions, digital platforms, and more.
- [Enterprise Technology Consulting Services](https://www.bain.com/vector-digital/enterprise-technology/): Our enterprise tech consultants provide end-to-end solutions that address every element of your IT infrastructure, from systems & architecture to team training.

## Industry Expertise

- [Our Industry Expertise](https://www.bain.com/industry-expertise/): Leverage our industry expertise to discover new opportunities and achieve transformative results. We help envision what's possible and bridge the gap to success.
- [Advanced Manufacturing & Industrial Consulting Services](https://www.bain.com/industry-expertise/Advanced-manufacturing-services/): From procurement and cost management to supply chain and digital, we work with companies in all industrial sectors to solve a broad range of challenges.
- [Aerospace & Defense Consulting](https://www.bain.com/industry-expertise/aerospace-defense-government-services/): Across nearly every A&D subsector, our aerospace and defense consultants help leaders solve the most challenging problems and emerge stronger than ever.
- [Agriculture Consulting Agribusiness](https://www.bain.com/industry-expertise/agribusiness/): Our agriculture consulting teams have helped clients across every region and sector grow sustainably, transform cost structures, and update operating models.
- [Automotive Consulting](https://www.bain.com/industry-expertise/automotive/): Our global experience and track record enable us to provide the automotive consulting expertise you need to stay ahead in a highly dynamic industry.
- [Aviation Consulting Airlines](https://www.bain.com/industry-expertise/aviation/): Our airline consulting expertise can help you anticipate, respond to and ultimately convert aviation industry challenges into opportunities.
- [Building Products & Technologies](https://www.bain.com/industry-expertise/building-products-technologies/): We have extensive experience with building products and technologies companies - across manufacturing, distribution, and construction. We can help you identify and maximize the many opportunities this dynamic sector presents.
- [Chemicals Consulting](https://www.bain.com/industry-expertise/chemicals/): Our chemicals consultants have applied their expertise in thousands of cases globally, across market segments, and in nearly every major chemical subsector.
- [Construction & Infrastructure Consulting](https://www.bain.com/industry-expertise/construction-infrastructure/): Our infrastructure and construction consultants have helped companies across the industry achieve exceptional results for decades.
- [Consumer Products Consulting Services](https://www.bain.com/industry-expertise/consumer-products/): Our CPG experts drive brand growth and commercial excellence for leading companies worldwide. Explore our CPG consulting services here.
- [Energy Consulting Natural Resources](https://www.bain.com/industry-expertise/energy-and-natural-resources/): Our energy consultants have delivered breakthrough solutions for clients in every sector of the industry, with our cutting-edge digital tools, analytics & insights.
- [Financial Services Consulting](https://www.bain.com/industry-expertise/financial-services/): With deep experience across every sector of financial services, our consultants work side-by-side with clients to develop and implement clear action plans.
- [Banking Consulting Retail, Commercial, Private](https://www.bain.com/industry-expertise/financial-services/banking/): Our banking consultants work alongside all types of banks commercial, private, retail to develop & implement strategies that address immediate challenges.
- [Insurance Consulting Services](https://www.bain.com/industry-expertise/financial-services/insurance/): Our insurance consultants help every type of insurer property & casualty, life, health, reinsurers, and more become more nimble, profitable, and efficient.
- [Healthcare Consulting Services | Healthcare & Life Sciences](https://www.bain.com/industry-expertise/healthcare/): Our healthcare & life science consultants provide solutions for strategy, operations, organization, M&A, and digital challenges while seizing opportunities.
- [Machinery & Equipment Consulting](https://www.bain.com/industry-expertise/industrial-machinery-equipment/): Our machinery & heavy equipment consultants have spent decades working with the world's largest industrials, pure-play systems & component suppliers.
- [Media & Entertainment Consulting Services](https://www.bain.com/industry-expertise/media-and-entertainment/): Our media & entertainment consultants can equip you with the data, insights and tools you need to anticipate what’s next, pivot as needed, and transform.
- [Metals Consulting](https://www.bain.com/industry-expertise/metals/): Our metal consultants help the world’s top performing extractors and manufacturers achieve the operational efficiencies that power breakthrough results.
- [Mining Consulting](https://www.bain.com/industry-expertise/mining/): Our mining consultants have experience across the production cycle, from upstream mining & raw material inputs to metal production, fabrication & distribution.
- [Oil & Gas Consulting](https://www.bain.com/industry-expertise/oil-gas/): Our oil and gas consultants work with clients across the industry, from exploration and production, to midstream operations, marketing, and equipment.
- [Paper & Packaging Consulting](https://www.bain.com/industry-expertise/paper-packaging/): Our paper & packaging experts have helped suppliers and manufacturers across industry sectors set bold ambitions and execute them flawlessly.
- [Private Equity Consulting](https://www.bain.com/industry-expertise/private-equity/): Bain & Company is the leading consulting partner to the private equity industry and its stakeholders. We advise investors across the entire investment cycle.
- [Retail Consulting Services](https://www.bain.com/industry-expertise/retail/): Leveraging lessons from thousands of retail industry projects, our retail consultants provide tailored strategies to meet today's challenges & opportunities.
- [Social Impact Consulting](https://www.bain.com/industry-expertise/social-impact-consulting/): Drawing on our work across the private, public & social sectors, we help our clients reach full potential and create transformative impact around the world.
- [Technology Consulting](https://www.bain.com/industry-expertise/technology/): Our technology consultants utilize cross-sector expertise and global insights to help tech companies compete and thrive among constant industry innovation.
- [Telecom Consulting Telecommunications](https://www.bain.com/industry-expertise/telecommunications/): Our telecommunications consultants have transformed business for major players across the telecom industry. We've helped over 90% of the world's top 30 telcos.
- [Transportation Consulting](https://www.bain.com/industry-expertise/transportation/): Our consulting expertise across transportation, logistics & digitally enabled mobility, ensures that your company keeps people moving more efficiently than ever.
- [Utilities & Renewable Energy Consulting](https://www.bain.com/industry-expertise/utilities-renewables/): Our utilities consultants help clients enhance virtually all facets of their operations, from power generation to trading and storage, transmission to retail.

## Our Latest Insights

- [Bain Insights & Publications](https://www.bain.com/insights/): Discover Bain's insights with proprietary data and expert analysis on key business issues. Stay ahead with our latest research and bold thinking.

## Careers at Bain

- [Careers at Bain](https://www.bain.com/careers/): Find a career at Bain. Your future self will thank you.

## About

- [About Bain](https://www.bain.com/about/): We are one of the world's leading management consulting firms, where bold thinking, inspired people and a passion for results come together for extraordinary impact.
- [Press Releases](https://www.bain.com/about/media-center/press-releases/): Explore the latest press releases from Bain & Company, including company announcements, research highlights, and media statements.
- [Further: Our Global Responsibility](https://www.bain.com/about/further/): Further is our collective ambition to create a more sustainable, equitable, and inclusive world. A journey to transform businesses and communities for the better.
- [Our People](https://www.bain.com/about/our-people/): We bring a fresh perspective and infectious energy to every client relationship. Our emphasis on teamwork, trust and tolerance for diverging opinions helps clients focus on their opportunities, build their capabilities and win the future. Together, we achieve results that bridge what is with what can be.
- [What We Believe](https://www.bain.com/about/what-we-believe/): We seek out people and clients who challenge themselves to be exceptional and champion that spirit in others. We're guided by True North, our unwavering commitment to always do the right thing by our clients, people and communities.
- [What We Do](https://www.bain.com/about/what-we-do/): We work with ambitious clients who want to define the future, not hide from it.
- [Our Team](https://www.bain.com/our-team/): In every Bain office, on every team, you’ll find passionate, collaborative people who care for you and your success. Learn more about our extraordinary team here.
- [Client Results](https://www.bain.com/client-results/): We work with clients who do not hide from the future but want to define it. Learn more by reading some of our client results stories.
- [Global Offices](https://www.bain.com/about/offices/): At Bain, we work seamlessly together as one firm to serve our clients wherever they need us. With offices across dozens of cities in countries all over the world, we make our collective knowledge, experience and global network available to our clients.
- [Privacy Policy](https://www.bain.com/about/privacy/): Bain knows that your privacy is important to you and takes user privacy very seriously. We are committed to protecting your personal data in accordance with this Privacy Policy.
